enemyStatusChance: Adds a {{chancePercent}}% chance to inflict {{statusEffect}} with attack moves
hp: Restore {{restorePoints}} HP or {{restorePercent}}% HP for one Pokémon, whichever is higher
fullHp: Fully restores HP for one Pokémon
fullHpStatus: Fully restores HP for one Pokémon and heals any status ailment
revive: Revive one Pokémon and restore {{restorePercent}}% HP
pp: Restore {{restorePoints}} PP for one Pokémon move
fullPp: Restore all PP for one Pokémon move
allPp: Restore {{restorePoints}} PP for all of one Pokémon's moves
fullAllPp: Restore all PP for all of one Pokémon's moves
ppUp: Permanently increase PP for one Pokémon move by {{upPoints}} for every 5 maximum PP (maximum 3)
tempStat: Increases the {{stat}} of all party members by 1 stage for 5 battles
attackBooster: Increases the power of a Pokémon's {{moveType}}-type moves by {{boostPercent}}%
baseStat: Increases the holder's {{stat}} by 10%, with a stack limit determined by its IV
expBooster: Increases gain of EXP. Points by {{boostPercent}}%
heldExpBooster: Increases the holder's gain of EXP. Points by {{boostPercent}}%
tera: {{teraType}} Terastallizes the holder for up to 10 battles
